kanzAlMahalliRecords.scope: One son's daughter, one full sister, or one paternal sister receives 1/2 subject to category conditions.
Two or more son's daughters, full sisters, or paternal sisters receive 2/3 collectively subject to category conditions.
Two or more uterine siblings receive 1/3 collectively.
One uterine sibling receives 1/6; one son's daughter with one direct daughter receives the complementary 1/6.

khulasaRecord.scope: The fixed-share, decrement, and exclusion tables corroborate the same fractions and category conditions.

sourceAgreement.detail: The two Shafi‘i sources agree on the listed fixed shares. Admission is limited to atoms whose unresolved residuary, generation, and special-case interactions are explicitly excluded.

atomicExclusions: No atom supplies a son's-son positive residuary share.
Son's-daughter atoms are limited to the repository's single normalized son's-descendant generation and exclude a son's son, a direct son, and unresolved rescue or nearer-generation questions.
Full- and paternal-sister fixed-share atoms exclude descendants, ascendants, corresponding brothers, and asabah ma‘a al-ghayr.
The paternal-sister complement atom is limited to exactly one full sister and one paternal sister.
The uterine group atom excludes mixed male/female group division, Mushtaraka, ascendants, and descendants.
unresolvedQuestions: Positive son's-son residuary rules remain only extracted and are not manually checked/source-corroborated.
The complete grandmother hierarchy remains absent from the corroborated Kanz record.
Sisters as residuaries with daughters remain extracted but not source-corroborated.
Full- and paternal-brother positive residuary modes remain outside the corroborated atomic corpus.
readinessBoundary: Only the named fixed-share atoms are ready; every unresolved interaction must fail whole-case coverage.
